jobs.title: Company Nurse
jobs.description_text: This role requires a unique combination of clinical nursing expertise and occupational safety specialization. The candidate must be a licensed nurse with Safety Officer certification and BOSH training, proficient in first aid, BLS, CPR, workplace health assessments, and HMO coordination. In addition, a candidate must be knowlegable of DOLE OSH standards, hazard assessment (HIRAC), incident investigation, emergency drill facilitation, and compliance documentation, skills that go beyond general nursing practice. Equally critical is their ability to design and implement employee wellness programs and mental health initiatives aligned with Republic Act 11036, as well as developing health education campaigns. This blend of regulatory compliance, risk management, and wellness program design is a rare, specialized competency not typically found among existing employees.

jobs.title: January 2027 Coal and Coke Quality Co-op (Engineering/Geology)
jobs.description_text: Start Date: January 2027 Duration: 8 to 12 months What we offer: At EVR, we're dedicated to supporting our workforce on their unique career journeys. Come experience what work life balance is all about! The Technical Marketing team is a small technical group consisting of both engineers and geologists who are responsible for ensuring coal and coke quality is on spec for all EVR customers. The team collaborates with mine planning, operations, processing, logistics and marketing to ensure that both current and future state coal and coke quality is understood. The team also conducts all research studies within EVR on the impact of external factors such as weathering or chemical addition, on coal and coke quality.

The incumbent will analyze corporate structures and review legal documentation from different provinces ensuring strict adherence to legislative guidelines and Bank policies. Extensive knowledge of AML guidelines is required. The environment is often fast–paced and requires effective time management skills.

jobs.title: Content Manager, Reverse Mortgage
jobs.description_text: The Work The Content Manager, Reverse Mortgage is responsible for building and managing an always-on content engine that helps EQ Bank grow its reverse mortgage business across both the broker and direct-to-consumer channels. The role combines strategy, editorial leadership and hands-on execution to create a consistent flow of clear, credible and useful content across written, digital and traditional formats. This role owns content planning across the full reverse mortgage decision system: homeowners, mortgage brokers and key influencers, particularly adult children. Grounded in the reverse mortgage growth strategy, the Content Manager will translate complex product information into audience- and stage-specific content that builds permission for homeowners, reassurance for families and confidence for brokers. A central focus is the direct-to-consumer funnel, with content intentionally designed to move prospects from awareness and education through consideration, nurture, application and advocacy.

jobs.title: Corporate Secretary
jobs.description_text: Purpose of the Job The Corporate Secretary, reporting to the General Counsel, is the Bank’s senior governance officer and a trusted advisor to the Board of Directors, Board Chair, Committee Chairs, Chief Executive Officer and executive leadership. The role safeguards the integrity of EQB’s governance framework, enables effective Board decision-making and ensures EQB Inc., Equitable Bank and their subsidiaries meet applicable corporate, securities, stock exchange and financial institution governance obligations. The Corporate Secretary leads the enterprise governance agenda, establishes governance standards, advises on complex Board and Committee matters and oversees corporate records, public-company reporting and insider compliance. The role ensures Board decisions are clearly documented, communicated and implemented, and operates with significant independence, discretion and judgment.

The studio’s job is to do more than move requests through the system; it should raise the quality, clarity and distinctiveness of the work EQ Bank puts into the world. The ambition is to make EQ Bank’s everyday creative output feel as considered and distinctive as its biggest brand moments. You will lead the ideas, craft, people and operating rhythm that turn business priorities into work people actually notice, understand and want to engage with.

jobs.title: Director, Product Marketing, Reverse Mortgage
jobs.description_text: The Work The Director, Product Marketing, Reverse Mortgage (REM) leads product marketing, supports go-to-market strategy and growth for EQ Bank’s Reverse Mortgage business. This role defines market positioning, customer value propositions and go-to-market strategies that build awareness, drive acquisition, deepen engagement and support portfolio growth across direct-to-consumer channels and business-to-business channels, including mortgage brokers, financial advisors and referral partners. As the primary marketing partner to the Reverse Mortgage business, the Director works closely with Product, Sales, Customer Experience, Digital, Operations, Enterprise Marketing and external partners to bring products and capabilities to market, sharpen competitive differentiation and deliver strong customer and partner experiences. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution. The successful candidate will translate customer, market and competitive insights into effective marketing strategies, lead a high-performing team and foster a culture of innovation, experimentation, collaboration and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Director, Strategy, Risk and Business Operations
jobs.description_text: The Work Reporting to the VP, Decumulation, the Director, Strategy, Risk & Business Operations is responsible for leading the strategic planning, business performance and enablement, governance, and risk management functions for the Reverse Mortgage and Insurance Lending business. Acting as the operational and strategic leader to the VP, Decumulation, this role ensures the business maintains a robust risk and control environment while delivering on growth, profitability, and customer objectives. The Director will oversee enterprise and business-specific risk activities including risk appetite monitoring, credit, operational, compliance, legal, conduct, model, and reputational risks. This leader will act as the primary liaison between the business and corporate Risk, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Audit, Governance and other business related risk functions such as Fraud Management while ensuring the business meets all regulatory, governance, and board reporting obligations. In addition, the Director will lead annual strategic planning, financial forecasting, business performance management, executive and Board reporting, KPI development, , enterprise initiatives, business enablement programs, and the development of new products and growth opportunities. The role requires a unique combination of strategic leadership, analytical rigor, operational execution, governance expertise, and cross-functional influence.

jobs.title: Financial Operations Administrator
jobs.description_text: The Work Reporting to the Director, Business Reporting and Settlement, the Financial Operations Administrator is responsible for supporting Equitable Bank's banking operations, payment processing activities, expense management administration, operational controls, reporting, and business continuity activities. The role is responsible for the administration of the Bank's corporate banking platforms, execution and monitoring of payment transactions, maintenance of banking infrastructure and access controls, administration of the Concur expense management platform, and support of Finance and Accounting operational activities. The incumbent acts as a key liaison with banking service providers and internal stakeholders to ensure banking transactions, reporting, and operational processes are executed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with established policies and controls.

jobs.title: Intern - Sales Operations & Strategy Associate Winter 2027

jobs.title: Lead AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description_text: Purpose of the Job: The Lead AI Platform Engineer is accountable for technical leadership, engineering excellence, reliability, operability, and the controlled enablement of the organization’s enterprise AI platforms. This role provides hands-on technical leadership across AI platform design, implementation, automation, observability, and production readiness. The incumbent ensures AI platform services and solutions are secure, resilient, observable, supportable, and compliant with enterprise standards for reliability, security, platform management, monitoring, incident coordination, and governance control enforcement. The incumbent acts as a senior technical lead for platform engineering activities, guiding implementation decisions, establishing engineering patterns, mentoring team members, and partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to enable the safe and scalable adoption of AI across the enterprise.

jobs.title: Lead, Business System Analyst
jobs.description_text: Purpose of Job The Lead Business System Analyst (BSA) will facilitate the identification and documentation of detailed user stories (functional requirements), process and system flows and contribute to the overall user experience, technical solution and acceptance criteria for Enterprise Technology and Data strategic projects and programs. The Lead BSA will be a core member within a cross-functional Pod that is delivers using hybrid-agile methodology and tools. The Lead BSA Lead will work with stakeholder groups across the Enterprise Technology and Data portfolios, including Finance, Risk, Treasury, Fraud, AML, and multiple Technology teams and suppliers. EQ Bank uses the latest suite of Atlassian tools (JIRA, Confluence, and add-ons) for capturing epics, user stories, flows, technical design documents, testing, and sprint-based execution.

jobs.title: Lead, Program Governance & Enablement
jobs.description_text: Purpose of the Job: The Lead, Program Governance & Enablement is an individual contributor role within the Integration Management Office (IMO). Working directly with the Senior Director, Program Management, the incumbent plays a key role in driving integration execution, governance effectiveness, and delivery outcomes across the program. The role is responsible for leading assigned integration workstreams, initiatives, and cross-functional deliverables while also providing governance, reporting, and program management support across the broader integration. The incumbent works with stakeholders across business and corporate functions to drive milestones, manage risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and actions, and help remove blockers that may impact program delivery. In addition, the role brings together information from across the program to produce executive materials, governance reporting, and actionable insights for leadership decision-making. The role works closely with senior leaders, workstream owners, and delivery teams to ensure integration commitments are progressing as planned and that emerging issues are identified and addressed promptly. The role provides broad exposure across the integration, including the Executive Steering Committee, IMO All Hands, leadership updates, the integration program management platform, and consolidated reporting on contracts, Transition Service Agreements, synergies, and benefits. jobs.title: Manager, Model Validation
jobs.description_text: The Work The Manager, Model Validation reports to the Director, Model Risk Management and supports the delivery of model validation activities across the Bank. The role executes validation procedures, contributes to validation strategies, and supports the effective management of model risk in accordance with the Bank's Model Risk Management Framework and applicable regulatory requirements. The scope includes models used for credit and treasury risk management, including AIRB and IFRS 9 ECL, interest rate risk, liquidity risk, and stress testing approaches used to support ICAAP. The role works closely with model risk stakeholders and conducts detailed reviews of model methodologies, assumptions, intended use, limitations, inputs, implementation, and performance. Responsibilities include completing benchmark and outcome analyses, documenting issues and recommendations, drawing evidence-based conclusions, and preparing model validation reports in accordance with the Bank's Model Risk Management Framework (MRMF). The primary focus is the execution of model validation activities, with additional support provided for model governance activities such as regulatory self-assessments, annual attestations, and risk reporting.

jobs.title: Manager, Risk Data & Model Implementation
jobs.department: Risk and AML/ATF Data, Analytics & Insight
jobs.description_text: The Work The Manager, Risk Data & Model Implementation (“MDMI”) reports to the Senior Manager, Risk Data & Model Implementation (“SMRDMI”), and supports the SMRDMI, the Senior Director, Risk Data & Model Operations and other Senior Management concerning all aspects of Enterprise Risk Management (“ERM”) activities within the Bank under the aspects of Model Implementation (“MI”) with the risk management function. The Manager will play a crucial role in supporting the model implementation and risk delivery, and shape its future in the Bank. With the multidisciplinary nature of this role, the ideal candidate is expected to have a solid understanding of Credit Risk Model development and delivery, data management pipeline and their related technologies. The role will be accountable for delivering implementation specifications and conduct production data assessment for any model implementations for EQB’s Advanced Internal Ratings Based (“AIRB”) approach for Pillar I regulatory capital models, the Internal Capital Adequacy Assessment Process (“ICAAP”) for Pillar II credit risk models, for IFRS 9 provisioning. This role will play a crucial supporting role in building an efficient way to implement risk models and risk reporting data within Equitable Bank.

This role requires the individual to possess a high degree of knowledge, experience, and well developed interpersonal, communication and leadership skills. Strong organization and multi-tasking skills are a must. The individual should be able to work independently, take initiative, and have good attention to detail.

jobs.description_text: The Work The Senior Director, AI Enablement & Platforms is a senior enterprise leader within the Enterprise AI team, accountable for making approved AI capabilities accessible, governed, reliable, supportable and adoptable at scale across EQB. The role leads enterprise AI enablement and adoption, and provides stewardship of the platforms and operating services that underpin a trusted employee and developer experience. The role sets the strategy and operating model for AI platform onboarding, access, service management, support, reliability, observability, lifecycle management, vendor coordination and cost transparency. It partners with Data & AI Governance, AI Engineering, AI Architecture, Cybersecurity, Risk, Privacy, Legal, Infrastructure and business teams to scale AI responsibly and securely without duplicating their accountabilities. The role leads the Manager, AI Platform Operations and Manager, AI Enablement, combining operational excellence with workforce readiness, learning pathways, reusable enablement patterns, communities of practice, communications and stakeholder engagement. Success is measured through responsible adoption, service health, user experience, control effectiveness, productivity and demonstrable business value—not through hands-on solution engineering or innovation-lab delivery.

jobs.description_text: The Work The Senior Director, Enterprise Execution is responsible for helping EQB translate strategic priorities into business outcomes. Working directly with executive leaders across the organization, this role leads a focused portfolio of the Bank's most important enterprise initiatives and strategic priorities. These are high-impact, cross-functional efforts that are critical to delivering EQB's strategy, growth ambitions, and financial objectives. The role serves as a bridge between strategy, execution, and outcomes, ensuring that the Bank's biggest priorities maintain momentum, overcome obstacles, and deliver the impact they were intended to achieve. Enterprise Execution acts as an execution partner to leadership, bringing structured problem-solving, strategic thinking, and execution discipline to a select group of enterprise priorities. The role combines elements of strategy execution, enterprise leadership, organizational effectiveness, and executive problem-solving, helping translate strategic ambition into measurable results. jobs.title: Senior Director, Financial Planning and Analysis
jobs.description_text: The Work The Senior Director, Financial Planning and Analysis leads the Bank’s enterprise financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, and management reporting activities and oversees the Financial Planning & Analysis Centre of Excellence within the VP, Financial Planning & Analysis portfolio. The role establishes an integrated view of financial performance, outlook, risks, and opportunities to support executive decision-making and disciplined resource and capital allocation. The role partners with business and functional leaders to translate strategic priorities into financial plans, challenge assumptions, assess performance drivers, and provide timely, decision-useful insight. It is accountable for the quality, consistency, governance, and continuous improvement of planning and forecasting processes and for establishing a high-performing Financial Planning & Analysis Centre of Excellence that scales common standards, tools, models, data, and insight across the Bank.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, BES, Portfolio Management
jobs.description_text: The Work The Senior Manager, BES, Portfolio Management will be a key member of the Commercial Credit team, reporting to the Director, BES, Portfolio Management. The incumbent will be responsible for mentoring and providing guidance to team members while ensuring the team operates efficiently and effectively in the prudent underwriting of complex conventional commercial mortgage loans secured by major asset classes in markets throughout Canada. Commercial mortgage loans range in size and up to $5.0 million. Key responsibilities include prudent oversight of the BES portfolio, ensuring credit risk is thoroughly assessed and within the Bank’s risk appetite. Additionally, the incumbent is responsible for ensuring that ongoing loan monitoring, annual reviews, renewals, and amendments/modifications are reviewed and assessed within approved guidelines. Along with the BES Portfolio Manager and the Director, the Senior Manager will monitor the renewal and annual review pipeline reports, manage credit flow and approve or recommend commercial mortgage renewals and annual reviews according to assigned delegation of authority. In addition, the Senior Manager will support the Bank’s goal of delivering a superior customer experience by proactively addressing issues as they arise while ensuring that team members complete underwriting assignments quickly and efficiently.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Lifecycle Management Strategy
jobs.description_text: The Work The Senior Manager, Lifecycle Management Strategy, is the owner of lifecycle strategy for the credit card portfolio. The role defines and executes integrated product, marketing and digital strategies across the cardholder journey to drive onboarding, activation, engagement, product usage, retention, loyalty and long-term customer engagement. Combining product knowledge, deep marketing expertise and business acumen, the Senior Manager translates customer insights, portfolio priorities and market opportunities into an actionable lifecycle roadmap. The role partners closely with Product, Digital, Marketing, Data and Analytics, Operations and Finance and teams to deliver coordinated customer experiences and measurable business outcomes. The successful candidate will possess a unique blend of marketing strategy, product, and analytical expertise, coupled with exceptional relationship-building and influencing skills. Working collaboratively with internal teams and external partners, they will lead the development of customer-centric engagement strategies, align stakeholders around shared business objectives, and identify innovative opportunities to strengthen customer relationships and accelerate portfolio growth.

The incumbent will lead complex analytical initiatives, drive methodological enhancements, support regulatory and audit activities, and champion the adoption of advanced analytics, automation, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to improve efficiency, insight generation, and risk management practices across the Bank.

jobs.description_text: The Work This role leads the design, implementation, and operation of security controls for Artificial Intelligence (AI), generative AI, machine learning, AI agents, copilots, automation platforms, agentic AI platforms, orchestration frameworks, model providers, and the cloud services that support them. jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add a Senior Mechanical Engineer to our Mechanical Engineering team. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing space hardware for leading-edge communications satellites, we would like to hear from you. In this position, you will be responsible for mechanical design aspects of Cesium phased array antennas, subsystems, and interfaces through all phases of the development process. The ideal candidate will be versatile and proficient in mechanical analysis, electronics packaging, computer-aided design (CAD), mechanical interfaces, thermal architecture, spacecraft propulsion, deployable and actuated structures, and environmental qualification of spacecraft antennas and payloads. You will be responsible for mechanical designs from concept through space flight including requirements definition, architecture trades and block diagrams, analysis, manufacturing, testing, qualification, and in-orbit support. The successful candidate will also present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team, as well as participate in proposal-writing efforts. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.

Our Senior Recruiting Coordinators play an important role in shaping how candidates experience CesiumAstro. For many candidates, you will be one of their first interactions with the company and one of the first faces they meet onsite. How we communicate, how prepared we are, and how we show up throughout the process matters. You will lead critical analyses, influence system-level design decisions, and provide technical guidance on spectrum strategy, compliance, and performance optimization.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Safety Engineer (CA)
jobs.description_text: LTA is seeking a Systems Safety Engineer to serve as a senior individual contributor and technical authority within the Systems Engineering function. Operating at the principal level, this engineer applies broad mastery across subsystems and disciplines beyond their core area to architect and validate new, complex system-of-systems and integration approaches where no legacy solution exists. The Principal Systems Engineer sets the overarching technical direction for a systems discipline, owns the system-level safety, verification, and certification strategy for a vehicle program or major system, and acts as a subject-matter expert during internal audits and regulatory interactions. This is a role for a proven technical leader who provides leadership and direction to multidisciplinary, integrated product teams, mentors and develops senior engineering staff, shapes program-defining architectures and drives the integration and certification of lighter-than-air flight vehicles. The base salary range for this role is $165,000 - 230,000, which is determined based on experience, geography, and qualifications.

jobs.description_text: Manager, Cost Accounting DESCRIPTION The Manager, Cost Accounting will own and lead the cost accounting and inventory accounting functions within the Accounting team. This role will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of manufacturing costs and inventory balances, supporting the month-end close and budgeting processes, and providing financial insights to support operational and business decision-making. Reporting directly to the Controller, the Manager, Cost Accounting will work closely with the broader Finance and Accounting team and partner cross-functionally with Operations, Supply Chain, Engineering, and other teams throughout the organization. We are looking for someone with strong cost accounting and manufacturing experience who can both manage day-to-day accounting activities and help develop and scale our processes as the organization grows. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, comfortable working with detailed operational data, and able to translate complex cost information into meaningful financial insights. Experience within aerospace & defense, automotive, or another complex manufacturing environment is preferred. The compensation range for this role is $130,000 - $170,000/yr This is the lowest-to-highest compensation range we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.

Your initial focus will be on building an exposure screening product for insured fleets, enabling customers to load their insured fleet, attach policy values, and continuously monitor exposure and accumulation against the live global fleet picture. This is a high-impact opportunity to build a new product category from the ground up. You will work directly with underwriters, brokers, P&I clubs, claims and exposure-management teams, as well as Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, and Marketing, to ensure the product solves real customer problems and establishes Kpler as a trusted source of marine insurance intelligence. Your initial focus will be on building live fleet monitoring and catch and yield reporting, enabling procurement and compliance teams to monitor vessels, understand fishing activity, and access reliable information to support their due-diligence and traceability requirements. jobs.title: Director of Agricultural Development
jobs.description_text: Rainmaker is pioneering a modern precipitation enhancement cloud seeding system to solve water scarcity. We develop and incorporate radar validation, weather-resistant UAS, and numerical weather modeling to make water abundant. As Rainmaker’s Director of Agricultural Development, you will own our engagement with the U.S. Department of Agriculture and the agricultural community in Washington. You will build the programs, partnerships, and funding pathways that connect precipitation enhancement to the conservation and water supply needs of American producers, and you will own the Congressional relationships and coalition presence that make the work durable. This position is based in Washington, DC. Significant stock options with high potential upside as an early-stage company 401(k) with employer matching Full health coverage (medical, dental, and vision insurance) Relocation assistance provided (if applicable) Unlimited PTO Paid parental leave for both parents

jobs.title: NPI Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description_text: Join the Future of Robotic Biomanufacturing! Multiply Labs is a robotics company on a mission to solve a significant bottleneck in modern medicine: the manufacturing of life-saving advanced biologics, from gene and cell therapies to antibodies and more. Today, these therapies are produced through manual, labor-intensive processes. Costs are extremely high—often $500K–$2M per patient—limiting access to only a small fraction of those who need them. As product complexity increases and the cost of failure and scientific labor rises, the industry is shifting toward automation. Robotics and AI are making automated biologics manufacturing feasible, reliable, and economically scalable. We believe the future of biomanufacturing is robotic—closed, automated, and scalable—ensuring critical therapeutics are accessible to every patient who needs them. Why This Matters We don’t just build robots—we’re building the essential infrastructure for next generation biologics. Our technology enables biopharma companies to scale production without redesigning their science, reducing regulatory hurdles and lowering costs so these treatments can reach more patients. The Stack & The Scale The Mission: Build the world’s best robots to make life-saving therapies accessible to all. The Technology: Advanced robotic orchestration, high-precision automation, cloud-integrated hardware-software systems, dextrous manipulation, and imitation learning. The Location: Headquartered in San Francisco, CA. The Backin
